extraction.notes: Whole annex read (pages 1-88). Text-file page numbers equal the printed page numbers. Each step assessment is a table; items from the Commission assessment column carry no table flag because it is running prose, items from the checks, double funding and conclusion rows carry the table flag. Technology steps assessed in this release: the Law on Electronic Communications (June 2025 step, reassessed after amendments of December 2025, again not achieved, grace period to 30 June 2026) and trust services and the EU Third Countries trusted list (December 2025 step, not achieved, grace period to 31 December 2026). The beneficiary's own conclusions are recorded as reported_view findings. Theme-doubtful: the school Internet and IT equipment step (achieved, 164 schools) and the e-rabota software upgrade in the informal economy reform. The step text, baseline and deadline rows restate Annex I conditions (MKD-EU-2024-007) and are not extracted; evidence lists and double-funding conclusions are not extracted. No Chapter 2 material: the law on seasonal, occasional and temporary work and the informal employment figures (pages 50-51) are general labour-market policy outside the run record's Chapter 2 boundary. Left out as not material under rules 0.4: the reduction of e-auctions in public procurement and the Electronic System for Public Procurement figures (pages 9-10; the claim is about the auction method, not the online service; borderline, not flagged); the excel-based Public Investment Management Information System (pages 14-15, back-office); the Public Revenue Office internal electronic procedures (page 50, back-office); the methodology for optimising administrative procedures to be developed by the Ministry of Digital Transformation (page 49, no digital content); enterprise digital transformation of the railway operator (page 67, sector system); Intelligent Transport Systems (page 68); digital forensic analysts (page 80). Period covered not given in the register or annex; left empty. Second-pass check done (G3 condition 2), see review/RUN-2026-01/second_pass/.
